label: Los Angeles (city)

county_election_office.name: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk (LAVote.gov), 12400 Imperial Hwy, Norwalk

zip_caveats: The USPS puts 'Los Angeles, CA' on mail for many places that are not in the City of Los Angeles, and those voters do NOT get the Mayor, City Attorney, Council or city measures (TE, LA, PL, EE, PRK, PRT, FD). Watch these: 90035 and 90036 straddle the city line with Beverly Hills and unincorporated areas; 90046 and 90069 are split between LA (Hollywood Hills) and West Hollywood; 90048 is split between LA (Fairfax, Beverly Grove) and West Hollywood; 90034 and 90066 (Mar Vista, Palms) border Culver City; 90045 (Westchester) is city but 90293 (Playa del Rey) and 90094 (Playa Vista) mix city and county pockets; 90008, 90043, 90047, 90056, 90059 and 90062 include unincorporated View Park, Windsor Hills, Ladera Heights, Athens and Florence-Graham; 90210 is mostly Beverly Hills but includes a sliver of LA; 90265 (Malibu) and 90402 (Santa Monica) are other cities; 90291 (Venice) is city but 90292 (Marina del Rey) is mostly county. Boyle Heights (90033, 90023) is city; East LA (90022) is unincorporated county. Downtown and the Arts District (90012, 90013, 90014, 90015, 90017, 90021) are all city. Charter Amendment SC is decided by LAUSD voters, which includes some non-city voters and excludes a few city voters. The only reliable check is the address lookup at lavote.gov/isb. Districts (added Oct 17): the City of LA spans 11 U.S. House districts (CD-26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 32, 34, 36, 37, 43, 44), 4 State Senate districts with a race this year (SD-20, 24, 26, 28) and 13 Assembly districts (AD-40, 42, 43, 44, 46, 51, 52, 54, 55, 57, 61, 65, 66), so most ZIPs touch more than one and the guide asks which is yours. A rough guide: the north and east Valley (Sylmar, Pacoima, Sun Valley, Panorama City, Van Nuys, North Hollywood) is mostly CD-29 and SD-20, with AD-43, AD-44 or AD-46. Granada Hills and most of Northridge are CD-27; Chatsworth and Porter Ranch are CD-32; all four are AD-40. Studio City, Sherman Oaks, Encino, Tarzana and Woodland Hills are CD-32 (parts of Woodland Hills and West Hills are CD-26), with AD-44 or AD-46. Sunland-Tujunga is CD-30 and AD-44. Bel Air, Brentwood and the Palisades are CD-32 with AD-42 or AD-51. Eagle Rock, Highland Park, El Sereno, Echo Park and Silver Lake are CD-34 or CD-30 and AD-52. Watts and Harbor Gateway North are CD-43; San Pedro, Wilmington, Harbor City and Harbor Gateway South are CD-44, with AD-65 or AD-66. Only even-numbered State Senate districts vote this year, so some LA voters live in an odd-numbered district and have no Senate race. LA County Supervisor and LAUSD board races were all decided in June, so none are on this ballot. ZIPs added Oct 17: 90001, 90002 and 90003 (South LA and Watts; parts are unincorporated Florence-Graham and Willowbrook), 90008 (Baldwin Hills, Crenshaw, Leimert Park; parts are unincorporated) and 90095 (UCLA). Harbor Gateway ZIPs (90247, 90248, 90501, 90502) are mostly Gardena and Torrance, so they are not listed. Small parts of the city also vote in Las Virgenes Unified (Woodland Hills), Inglewood Unified Area 2 (near 90056) and Water Replenishment District Division 3 (Harbor area); those races are not in this guide. The address lookup at lavote.gov/isb is the reliable check.
